St. Ioannikios the Great

Saints

St. Ioannikios the Great

St. Joannicius the Great · Ioannikius · Ioannikios · Joannicius

Period
752–846 in the cited OCA life
Region
Bithynia; Mount Olympus region
Titles / vocation
Monastic
Commemoration
November 4

Introduction

A former soldier who became a Byzantine monk and hermit. The OCA associates him with a short prayer addressed to the Holy Trinity.

Read the published life [1]

BackgroundLife and notable eventsDeath and martyrdomPrayer and remembranceChronology
Death / martyrdom

Repose in monastic life, November 4, 846, in the cited account

Read circumstances and sources

Background

The OCA life gives Marikat in Bithynia as his birthplace and 752 as his birth year. It describes a poor childhood spent tending the family’s cattle.

[1] Official Orthodox life · Opening paragraph

Life and notable events

After six years in imperial military service, he sought monastic solitude. An elder first required community life; he learned to read and write and memorized Psalms. His later life included solitary prayer, monastic tonsure, and residence at several ascetic sites.

[1] Official Orthodox life · Military service through later monasteries

Death and martyrdom

The life records his repose on November 4, 846, aged ninety-four. It describes a monastic death, rather than execution.

[1] Official Orthodox life · Final paragraph

Prayer and remembrance

His remembrance combines psalmody with a Trinitarian prayer still used in Orthodox prayer books. The OCA also recounts healings and deliverances as part of his received hagiographic life.

[1] Official Orthodox life · Prayer after Psalm verses; miracle narratives

Chronology

  1. 752

    Birth according to the OCA life.

    [1] Official Orthodox life · Opening paragraph

  2. November 4, 846

    Repose according to the OCA life.

    [1] Official Orthodox life · Final paragraph
